items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 42:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the Reshimot that illuminate from afar? The Mochin of YESHSUT, which the Nukva does not receive from ZA except by the bowing of the head of ZA to his NHY, which became HGT, where Jacob and Rachel stand and receive from him, are discerned as the illumination of the Reshimo from above downward, as above in Answer 31. They are also called the illumination of the Reshimo, from afar. (Item 47).
